decisions.reason: The operator training programme is peripheral and likely below aspiration, so problemistic search makes dropping likely.
As a complementary rotary axis accessory, it supports core machine sales and organisational slack allows keeping it despite uncertain returns.
Hybrid additive post-processing is outside the firm's established strengths and likely underperforms, triggering problemistic search and divestment.
The high-speed CNC milling machine is a core product that likely meets aspirations and is central to the firm's machinery portfolio.
The automatic tool change system complements existing machines and is likely retained because it enhances customer value and supports the core business.
